args.summary: The latest deploy of checkout-api, v2.3.1, began failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. In response, the service was rolled back in all production regions to the most recent release that was healthy in production, v2.3.0. Post-rollback verification confirms the service is healthy again with an error rate of ~0.2%. Root cause of the v2.3.1 regression still needs investigation.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: The latest deploy, **v2.3.1**, was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. Post-rollback verification confirms the service is healthy again (error rate dropped to ~0.2%).
3. **Opened SEV2 incident**: Created incident **INC-0001** documenting the v2.3.1 regression, the rollback action, and the recovery — the on-call engineer has been paged to investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure.
